## File: facebookresearch_sam-3d-objects/sam3d_objects/model/backbone/tdfy_dit/modules/transformer/blocks.py

Prompts

```
['build a python module to create sinusoidal position embeddings for spatial coordinates using AbsolutePositionEmbedder', 'create a FeedForwardNet module with GELU activation and configurable MLP ratio for transformer architectures', 'build a TransformerBlock with multi-head self-attention and feed-forward network supporting full or windowed attention modes', 'build a TransformerCrossBlock with self-attention, cross-attention, and feed-forward network for encoder-decoder transformer models', 'test the TransformerBlock and TransformerCrossBlock forward passes with gradient checkpointing enabled', 'build a ModulatedTransformerBlock with self-attention and FFN using adaptive layer norm conditioning', 'build a ModulatedTransformerCrossBlock with self-attention, cross-attention, and FFN using adaptive layer norm', 'build a MOTModulatedTransformerCrossBlock with per-latent ModuleDict layers for multi-object tracking', 'test the ModulatedTransformerBlock forward pass with input tensor and modulation tensor', 'review the adaLN_modulation mechanism that produces shift, scale, and gate parameters for MSA and MLP']
```

Usage

```
{'build_absolute_position_embedder': 'build a python module to create sinusoidal position embeddings for spatial coordinates using AbsolutePositionEmbedder', 'create_feedforward_net': 'create a FeedForwardNet module with GELU activation and configurable MLP ratio for transformer architectures', 'build_transformer_block': 'build a TransformerBlock with multi-head self-attention and feed-forward network supporting full or windowed attention modes', 'build_transformer_cross_block': 'build a TransformerCrossBlock with self-attention, cross-attention, and feed-forward network for encoder-decoder transformer models', 'test_transformer_blocks': 'test the TransformerBlock and TransformerCrossBlock forward passes with gradient checkpointing enabled'}
```
